title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 22 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Chronicles chapter 22 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 22 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Chronicles Chapter 22.

questions.question: What did David say the place was in 1 Chronicles 22:1?
options: The house of the LORD God and the altar of burnt offering
The palace of the king
The temple of Baal
The market of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The house of the LORD God and the altar of burnt offering
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:1 states that David said, 'This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.'

questions.question: Who did David command to gather together in the land of Israel according to 1 Chronicles 22:2?
options: The strangers
The priests
The prophets
The elders
questions.correctAnswer: The strangers
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:2 says David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel.

questions.question: What kind of workers did David set to hew stones for building the house of God?
options: Masons
Carpenters
Blacksmiths
Farmers
questions.correctAnswer: Masons
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:2 mentions that David set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 22:3, David prepared iron and brass for what purpose?
options: Nails for doors and joinings
Weapons for war
Coins for trade
Jewelry for the priests
questions.correctAnswer: Nails for doors and joinings
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:3 states David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance.

questions.question: Who brought much cedar wood to David as recorded in 1 Chronicles 22:4?
options: The Zidonians and they of Tyre
The Egyptians
The Babylonians
The Philistines
questions.correctAnswer: The Zidonians and they of Tyre
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:4 says the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

questions.question: Why did David say Solomon was suitable to build the house of the LORD in 1 Chronicles 22:5?
options: Because Solomon was young and tender
Because Solomon was a great warrior
Because Solomon was a prophet
Because Solomon was the eldest son
questions.correctAnswer: Because Solomon was young and tender
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:5 states David said Solomon was young and tender, and the house must be exceeding magnifical.

questions.question: What charge did David give to Solomon in 1 Chronicles 22:6?
options: To build a house for the LORD God of Israel
To lead the army into battle
To write songs and psalms
To govern the people alone
questions.correctAnswer: To build a house for the LORD God of Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:6 says David called for Solomon and charged him to build a house for the LORD God of Israel.

questions.question: True or False: David told Solomon that he himself had built the house for the LORD.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:7 explains David said it was in his mind to build the house, but he did not build it.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 22:8, why was David not allowed to build the house of the LORD?
options: Because he had shed much blood in great wars
Because he was too old
Because he lacked resources
Because he was not the chosen king
questions.correctAnswer: Because he had shed much blood in great wars
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:8 states the word of the LORD came to David forbidding him to build the house because he had shed much blood.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Chronicles 22:9 says Solomon will bring rest and peace to Israel.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:9 states Solomon will be a man of rest and the LORD will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

questions.question: What did the LORD promise Solomon in 1 Chronicles 22:10?
options: That he shall build a house for God's name and have an everlasting kingdom
That he shall never face enemies
That he shall be the richest king
That he shall be the mightiest warrior
questions.correctAnswer: That he shall build a house for God's name and have an everlasting kingdom
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:10 promises Solomon will build a house for the LORD and his throne will be established forever.

questions.question: What did David ask the LORD to give Solomon in 1 Chronicles 22:12?
options: Wisdom and understanding
Wealth and power
Strength and courage
Long life and health
questions.correctAnswer: Wisdom and understanding
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:12 says David prayed that the LORD would give Solomon wisdom and understanding to keep the law.

questions.question: True or False: David told Solomon to be afraid and dismayed while building the house of the LORD.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:13 tells Solomon to be strong and courageous and not to dread or be dismayed.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 22:14, what did David prepare for the house of the LORD?
options: Gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone
Only gold and silver
Only timber and stones
Weapons and armor
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:14 states David prepared vast amounts of gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone.

questions.question: In 1 Chronicles 22, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: David commands to gather strangers and set masons
David charges Solomon to build the house
David prepares gold and silver
David prays for Solomon's wisdom
questions.correctAnswer: David commands to gather strangers and set masons
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:2 is the earliest instruction where David commands to gather strangers and set masons, before charging Solomon or preparing materials.

medium.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 22 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Chronicles Chapter 22 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Why was David not allowed to build the house for the LORD according to 1 Chronicles 22?
options: Because he was too old
Because he had shed much blood and made great wars
Because he lacked wisdom
Because he was not chosen by God
questions.correctAnswer: Because he had shed much blood and made great wars
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:8 explains that the LORD told David he could not build the house because he had shed much blood and made great wars. This shows the importance of purity and peace in fulfilling God's purposes.

questions.question: What promise does the LORD make about Solomon in 1 Chronicles 22?
options: Solomon will be a great warrior
Solomon will build the house for God's name and have peace in his days
Solomon will rule over all nations
Solomon will never face enemies
questions.correctAnswer: Solomon will build the house for God's name and have peace in his days
questions.explanation: According to 1 Chronicles 22:9-10, God promises Solomon will be a man of rest who will build the house for His name, and peace and quietness will be given to Israel during Solomon's reign.

questions.question: How does David encourage Solomon as he charges him to build the house of the LORD?
options: To be strong and courageous and not fear
To seek riches and fame
To build quickly without delay
To rely on his own strength
questions.correctAnswer: To be strong and courageous and not fear
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:13 advises Solomon to be strong, courageous, and not dismayed while fulfilling God's statutes, emphasizing trust and obedience to God as keys to success.

questions.question: What does David say about the resources he prepared for the temple building?
options: He prepared a small amount of gold and silver
He prepared an abundance of gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone
He only prepared stones and timber
He left the preparation to Solomon
questions.correctAnswer: He prepared an abundance of gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:14 details David’s abundant preparations in gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone for the temple, showing his generosity and dedication to God's work.

questions.question: What does David ask the LORD to give Solomon as he builds the house?
options: Strength and power
Wisdom and understanding
Fame and wealth
Peace and quietness
questions.correctAnswer: Wisdom and understanding
questions.explanation: In 1 Chronicles 22:12, David prays for the LORD to grant Solomon wisdom and understanding to govern Israel and uphold God's law, highlighting the importance of divine guidance.

questions.question: What will happen if Solomon takes heed to fulfill the statutes and judgments given by Moses?
options: He will become king over all nations
He will prosper and be successful in building the house
He will live a long life
He will never be tested
questions.correctAnswer: He will prosper and be successful in building the house
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:13 promises prosperity to Solomon if he carefully obeys the laws and judgments given to Moses, teaching faithfulness leads to success.

questions.question: What does David urge the princes of Israel to do for Solomon?
options: To challenge him
To help Solomon build the house
To ignore the building project
To focus on their own territories
questions.correctAnswer: To help Solomon build the house
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:17 shows David commanding the princes to assist Solomon, emphasizing cooperation and unity in fulfilling God’s purpose.

questions.question: According to David, why should the princes of Israel support Solomon in building the temple?
options: Because Solomon is the strongest man
Because the LORD God has given them rest and subdued the land
Because they want to gain wealth
Because David commanded it
questions.correctAnswer: Because the LORD God has given them rest and subdued the land
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:18 explains that God has given rest and subdued the enemies, so supporting Solomon honors God's work and blessing.

questions.question: What is the purpose of building the sanctuary of the LORD according to David's final instruction?
options: To display the wealth of Israel
To bring the ark of the covenant and holy vessels into the house
To create a place for kings to meet
To impress neighboring nations
questions.correctAnswer: To bring the ark of the covenant and holy vessels into the house
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:19 states the sanctuary is to house the ark and holy vessels, signifying the dwelling place of God among His people.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 22 teach about reliance on God in leadership?
options: Leaders should depend on their own wisdom
Leaders should seek God's wisdom and obey His laws
Leaders must be strict and harsh
Leaders need to avoid responsibility
questions.correctAnswer: Leaders should seek God's wisdom and obey His laws
questions.explanation: Verses 12 and 13 emphasize that Solomon must receive wisdom from the LORD and obey His statutes, showing that godly leadership depends on divine guidance and obedience.

questions.question: What does David’s preparation of materials before his death teach about planning for God’s work?
options: God's work requires careful and generous preparation
Only the king should prepare
Preparation is unnecessary if God wills it
Preparation should be secret
questions.correctAnswer: God's work requires careful and generous preparation
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:5 and 14 show David's abundant preparation ahead of time, teaching that faithful planning honors God and supports successful ministry.

questions.question: True or False: David was permitted by God to build the temple because he was a man of peace.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:8 clearly states David was not allowed to build the temple because he had shed much blood and made great wars, indicating he was not a man of peace in this regard.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Chronicles 22, Solomon will have peace and quietness during his reign as the LORD promised.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:9 promises that Solomon will be given peace and quietness in his days, highlighting God's blessing on Solomon's reign.

questions.question: True or False: David tells Solomon not to fear or be dismayed if he follows the LORD’s statutes and judgments.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:13 encourages Solomon to be strong and courageous and not to fear or be dismayed while faithfully following God's commandments.

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 22:13 promise will happen if Solomon keeps the law of the LORD as charged to Moses?
options: He will become wealthy
He shall prosper
He will have many sons
He will be victorious in battle
questions.correctAnswer: He shall prosper
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:13 clearly states that Solomon will prosper if he carefully fulfills the statutes and judgments given by the LORD through Moses, showing the reward of obedience.

hard.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 22 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Chronicles Chapter 22.

questions.question: What types of skilled workers does 1 Chronicles 22:15 say are abundant to assist Solomon in building the house of the LORD?
options: Hewers, workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men
Only masons and carpenters
Farmers and shepherds
Soldiers and generals
questions.correctAnswer: Hewers, workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:15 specifically mentions 'hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men' as being abundant to help Solomon build the house of the LORD.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 22:16, what is said about the quantities of gold, silver, brass, and iron prepared for the temple?
options: There is no number to them, they are abundant
Only a small amount was prepared
Only gold and silver were prepared
They were insufficient and needed to be gathered more
questions.correctAnswer: There is no number to them, they are abundant
questions.explanation: Verse 16 states that 'Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number,' indicating the abundance of these materials for the temple work.

questions.question: Who did David command to assist Solomon in building the temple according to 1 Chronicles 22:17?
options: All the princes of Israel
Only the tribe of Levi
Foreign workers from Tyre
The priests alone
questions.correctAnswer: All the princes of Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:17 says David commanded 'all the princes of Israel' to help Solomon his son in the temple construction.

questions.question: What reason does David give in 1 Chronicles 22:18 for Israel’s rest and the subdued land?
options: The LORD your God is with you and has given you rest on every side
The military strength of Israel's armies
The alliances with neighboring nations
The wisdom of Solomon
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD your God is with you and has given you rest on every side
questions.explanation: David reminds the princes that the LORD is with them and has given rest and subdued the land as stated in verse 18.

questions.question: In 1 Chronicles 22:19, what two sacred items are mentioned as to be brought into the temple Solomon was to build?
options: The ark of the covenant and the holy vessels of God
The golden lampstand and the altar of incense
The tablets of the Ten Commandments and the ephod
The brazen altar and the laver
questions.correctAnswer: The ark of the covenant and the holy vessels of God
questions.explanation: Verse 19 exhorts to build the sanctuary to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy vessels of God into the house.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage does the promise in 1 Chronicles 22:10 about establishing Solomon’s throne forever most directly echo and fulfill?
options: 2 Samuel 7:12-16
Exodus 19:5-6
Genesis 12:3
Leviticus 26:3-13
questions.correctAnswer: 2 Samuel 7:12-16
questions.explanation: The promise that Solomon will have an established throne forever in 1 Chronicles 22:10 reflects the Davidic covenant in 2 Samuel 7:12-16 where God promises to establish David’s seed and throne forever.

questions.question: What literary device is notably used in David’s charge to Solomon in verses 11-13, combining encouragement and instruction in a balanced structure?
options: Chiasmus
Parable
Simile
Allegory
questions.correctAnswer: Chiasmus
questions.explanation: The balanced structure of encouragement and commands in verses 11-13 resembles a chiasm, a common Hebrew literary device emphasizing the central message through mirrored elements.

questions.question: The Hebrew word often translated as 'cunning men' in 1 Chronicles 22:15 refers to craftsmen skilled in what area?
options: Artisan skills including stonework and carpentry
Military strategy
Prophecy and priesthood
Agriculture and animal husbandry
questions.correctAnswer: Artisan skills including stonework and carpentry
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term for 'cunning men' refers to skilled artisans proficient in crafts such as stone cutting and carpentry, essential for temple construction as seen in verse 15.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 22:14, what materials did David prepare in abundance for the temple before his death?
options: Gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone
Only gold and silver
Only timber and stone
Only brass and iron
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone
questions.explanation: Verse 14 lists gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone as materials David prepared abundantly for the temple work.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Chronicles 22:8, David was forbidden by God to build the temple because he had shed much blood in wars.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 8 states that God told David he would not build the temple because he had shed much blood and made great wars.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Chronicles 22:12 indicates that Solomon's success depended solely on his own wisdom and understanding.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says, 'Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding,' indicating Solomon’s success depended on God giving him wisdom, not on his own alone.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 22:19 connect to the theme of the Ark of the Covenant seen in Exodus 25:10-22?
options: It commands bringing the Ark into the new sanctuary, fulfilling Exodus' instructions for its sacred place
It forbids moving the Ark from its resting place
It replaces the Ark with a golden calf
It does not mention the Ark at all
questions.correctAnswer: It commands bringing the Ark into the new sanctuary, fulfilling Exodus' instructions for its sacred place
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:19 instructs to bring the Ark of the Covenant into the temple, fulfilling the purpose given in Exodus 25:10-22 where God commands the Ark to be the sacred place of His presence.

questions.question: What is the significance of David gathering strangers and masons as mentioned in 1 Chronicles 22:2 in the context of ancient Near Eastern temple-building practices?
options: It reflects the common practice of employing foreign skilled labor for large state projects
It was unusual and forbidden to use foreigners in temple work
David only used family members for the work
The strangers were only guards, not workers
questions.correctAnswer: It reflects the common practice of employing foreign skilled labor for large state projects
questions.explanation: Verse 2 shows David gathering strangers and skilled masons, reflecting the ancient Near Eastern practice of recruiting foreign craftsmen for monumental building projects, as local expertise was sometimes insufficient.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the theme of God giving wisdom and understanding to leaders as in 1 Chronicles 22:12?
options: James 1:5
Romans 8:28
Acts 2:1-4
Hebrews 11:1
questions.correctAnswer: James 1:5
questions.explanation: James 1:5 encourages believers to ask God for wisdom, similar to the prayer in 1 Chronicles 22:12 where Solomon is asked to receive wisdom from the LORD to govern Israel.

questions.question: What was the original audience likely meant to understand about David’s preparations for the temple as expressed in 1 Chronicles 22:14-16?
options: That David’s abundant preparations demonstrated his devotion and ensured Solomon’s success
That David was hoarding wealth selfishly
That Solomon would not need any help in building the temple
That the temple was a minor project with little significance
questions.correctAnswer: That David’s abundant preparations demonstrated his devotion and ensured Solomon’s success
questions.explanation: The audience would see David’s vast preparations as a sign of his devotion and a foundation laid for Solomon to successfully build the temple, as verses 14-16 describe abundant resources and workers.

theological.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 22 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Chronicles Chapter 22 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What theological significance does David's preparation of materials for the temple before his death convey about God's providence?
options: God works through human preparation to accomplish His purposes
David's preparations were only for his own glory
The temple's construction was insignificant in God's plan
God requires only spiritual readiness, not physical preparation
questions.correctAnswer: God works through human preparation to accomplish His purposes
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:5 shows that David prepared abundantly before his death for the temple, indicating that God providentially uses human effort and preparation to fulfill divine plans. This aligns with biblical teaching on cooperation with God's will (cf. Proverbs 16:3).

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 22:8, why was David forbidden by God from building the temple?
options: Because he had shed much blood and waged great wars
Because he lacked the proper materials
Because Solomon was better qualified
Because he was too old to undertake the task
questions.correctAnswer: Because he had shed much blood and waged great wars
questions.explanation: Verse 8 explicitly states that David's extensive shedding of blood and wars disqualified him from building the temple, emphasizing God's holiness and the need for a peaceful rest in the temple builder, a principle reflecting divine justice.

questions.question: What divine attribute is highlighted in the promise that Solomon will be given rest from all his enemies and peace in Israel?
options: God’s faithfulness in establishing peace
God’s wrath against enemies
God’s indifference to human conflict
God’s judgment upon Solomon
questions.correctAnswer: God’s faithfulness in establishing peace
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:9 reveals God's faithfulness by promising Solomon rest and peace, showcasing God's covenantal commitment to provide security for His people, a key attribute of God as the God of peace (cf. Isaiah 9:6).

questions.question: How does David’s charge to Solomon in verses 11-13 reflect the doctrine of divine wisdom and obedience?
options: Solomon must rely on God’s wisdom and obey His laws to prosper
Solomon can build the temple by his own understanding
Obedience is optional if wisdom is great
Wisdom and obedience are unrelated to temple building
questions.correctAnswer: Solomon must rely on God’s wisdom and obey His laws to prosper
questions.explanation: Verses 11-13 emphasize that Solomon’s success depends on the LORD giving him wisdom and understanding, and on his adherence to God’s statutes, teaching the essential connection between divine wisdom, obedience, and blessing.

questions.question: What does the vast amount of gold, silver, brass, iron, timber, and stone prepared by David (verse 14) indicate about the nature of the temple?
options: The temple was intended to be a magnificent and enduring house for God
The temple was meant to be a temporary structure
Material wealth was the main focus of the temple
The temple was primarily a military fortress
questions.correctAnswer: The temple was intended to be a magnificent and enduring house for God
questions.explanation: Verse 14 describes abundant materials prepared for the temple, indicating it was designed to be magnificent and lasting, reflecting the glory of God’s dwelling among His people, consistent with Old Testament temple theology (cf. Exodus 25:8-9).

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 22:16 demonstrate God’s sovereignty in the success of Solomon’s temple-building project?
options: God’s presence and blessing empower Solomon to accomplish the work
Success depends solely on Solomon’s strength
The work is guaranteed regardless of God’s involvement
The project will fail without human effort alone
questions.correctAnswer: God’s presence and blessing empower Solomon to accomplish the work
questions.explanation: Verse 16 urges Solomon to arise and work with the assurance that the LORD is with him, highlighting God’s sovereign enabling power in human endeavors, a fundamental biblical principle (cf. Philippians 2:13).

questions.question: What broader redemptive narrative is reflected in David’s command to the princes to help Solomon and seek the LORD as they build the sanctuary (verses 17-19)?
options: God’s covenant community must unite in worship and obedience
The temple is a human institution independent of God
Solomon should build the temple alone without help
The sanctuary is a minor event with no covenant implications
questions.correctAnswer: God’s covenant community must unite in worship and obedience
questions.explanation: Verses 17-19 call the leaders to support Solomon and seek God, representing the unified covenant community preparing a dwelling place for God, foreshadowing the New Testament theme of the church as God’s dwelling (cf. Ephesians 2:19-22).

questions.question: Sceptics claim that David’s violent past disqualifies him entirely from any sacred role. What does 1 Chronicles 22:7-10 actually teach about David’s role in God’s plan?
options: David was chosen by God to prepare for the temple, but not to build it himself
David was rejected completely by God for his violence
David’s past has no bearing on his role in God’s plan
David built the temple despite God’s command
questions.correctAnswer: David was chosen by God to prepare for the temple, but not to build it himself
questions.explanation: Verses 7-10 teach that God forbade David from building the temple due to his wars but appointed him to prepare extensively, with Solomon as the peaceful builder, showing God’s justice balanced with His providence in redemption history.

questions.question: Which doctrine is emphasized by the promise in 1 Chronicles 22:10 that God will be Solomon’s father and establish his throne forever?
options: The doctrine of the Davidic covenant and divine sonship
The doctrine of human merit
The doctrine of temple sacrifices
The doctrine of predestination only
questions.correctAnswer: The doctrine of the Davidic covenant and divine sonship
questions.explanation: Verse 10 highlights God’s father-son relationship with Solomon and the eternal throne, affirming the Davidic covenant’s promise of an enduring kingdom and typologically pointing to Christ as the ultimate Son and King (cf. 2 Samuel 7:14).

questions.question: What combined doctrine emerges from analyzing David’s charge to Solomon about wisdom (v.12) and the necessity of obedience to the law (v.13)?
options: God grants wisdom to those who faithfully obey His law
Wisdom is irrelevant to obedience
Obedience guarantees wisdom regardless of God
Wisdom comes from human intellect alone
questions.correctAnswer: God grants wisdom to those who faithfully obey His law
questions.explanation: Verses 12 and 13 together teach that wisdom and understanding are divine gifts linked to faithful obedience, underscoring the biblical doctrine that true wisdom is inseparable from reverence and adherence to God’s commands (cf. James 1:5-8).

questions.question: What does the abundant supply of skilled workmen mentioned in verse 15 reveal about God’s providential provision for His work?
options: God provides both materials and skilled labor to accomplish His purposes
Human skill replaces the need for God’s involvement
The temple building was left to chance
Only a few workers were available for the task
questions.correctAnswer: God provides both materials and skilled labor to accomplish His purposes
questions.explanation: Verse 15 indicates that God’s providence includes supplying skilled laborers, demonstrating that divine plans are fulfilled through both resources and gifted people, reflecting the biblical view of God’s comprehensive care (cf. Exodus 31:3-5).

questions.question: How does David’s description of the altar and the house of the LORD in verse 1 underscore the holiness and centrality of worship in Israel’s life?
options: It signifies the sacred place where God meets His people
It is just a building with no spiritual significance
The altar was for social gatherings only
The house of the LORD was a political symbol only
questions.correctAnswer: It signifies the sacred place where God meets His people
questions.explanation: Verse 1 articulates the altar and house as the LORD’s dwelling and place of burnt offering, highlighting holiness and the covenantal focal point for worship and communion with God, foundational to Israel’s identity (cf. Exodus 29:42-43).

questions.question: Which divine attribute is emphasized by God’s promise to establish Solomon’s throne forever in verse 10?
options: God’s faithfulness and eternal sovereignty
God’s wrath and judgment
God’s mercy limited to one generation
God’s hiddenness
questions.correctAnswer: God’s faithfulness and eternal sovereignty
questions.explanation: Verse 10’s promise of an everlasting throne reveals God’s unwavering faithfulness to His covenant and His eternal sovereignty over Israel’s monarchy, reflecting a key biblical attribute (cf. Psalm 89:34-37).

questions.question: What theological insight is gained by synthesizing David’s gathering of strangers to help build the temple (verse 2) and his command to the princes to assist Solomon (verse 17)?
options: God’s work invites inclusion and communal cooperation beyond Israel
Temple building was an isolated activity
Only Israelites could build the temple
David acted independently without counsel
questions.correctAnswer: God’s work invites inclusion and communal cooperation beyond Israel
questions.explanation: Verses 2 and 17 show David mobilizing foreigners and Israel’s leaders alike, teaching that God’s purposes include broad cooperation and unity, reflecting the inclusive nature of God’s kingdom mission (cf. Isaiah 56:6-7).

questions.question: How do verses 18 and 19 together teach about God’s providential protection and the believer’s responsibility in sanctification?
options: God provides rest and conquest, and people must seek Him diligently
God leaves the work entirely to human effort
Believers have no role in seeking God for sanctification
God’s protection removes all human responsibility
questions.correctAnswer: God provides rest and conquest, and people must seek Him diligently
questions.explanation: Verses 18-19 affirm that God has subdued the land and given rest, but commands seeking the LORD and active building of the sanctuary, illustrating the synergy between divine provision and human faithful response in sanctification (cf. Philippians 2:12-13).
